name: CC-7700 frigate
description: The CC-7700 frigate was a class of frigate used by the Imperial Navy that was an updated version of the earlier Detainer CC-2200. The CC-7700 was an Interdictor vessel, due to its ability to emit an interdiction field, which prevented other ships from entering hyperspace and could be used to maroon vessels traveling at lightspeed. In 14 BBY, one CC-7700 formed part of a task force commanded by Moff Wilhuff Tarkin and was used in conjunction with other Interdictor vessels in a failed attempt to capture the rebel corvette Carrion Spike.
